comment_regular: GetItemCount_Eval (index 47 / opcode 0x102F), used 54 times in vanilla core dialogue. Requires a valid item form, a container subject, and ContainerChanges data; returns abs(base TESContainer count plus EntryData.countDelta). If no ContainerChanges data exists it returns 0. Fallout's analogue x4y6:0x823BCE90 also has a special form-type-85 leveled-list expansion loop; this Oblivion handler performs only a single lookup for the supplied ObjectID.
